product.title: Oahu: 60 Min Royal Crown Helicopter Tour - Doors Off or On

description.text: Explore Hawaii’s island of Oahu by air on this helicopter tour. Fly above the island and many of its most well-known landmarks, such as Diamond Head, Sacred Falls, the Dole Plantation, and Pearl Harbor.
